purpose: Canonical per-entity dossier migration tranche v41; preserve existing ABox identity and review metadata while materializing dedicated non-State dossier boundaries.
migrationRule: A migrated non-State entity must point to an existing dedicated type-appropriate dossier. Migration changes dossier placement only and creates no relation, participation, culpability, governance or licensing inference.
visualRule: Derived visuals render the referenced State dossier context and an identity-boundary evidence flow. State context never becomes an entity-level governance outcome.
